verdict_summary: 8 pass in the proposed file (5 unchanged, 3 after a recommended edit), 0 rejected. Edits: ophalen retagged overig (the child's school is daily life, as 016-medicijn-school and 017-eerste-schooldag); werkschoenen adequacy criterion and note widened so that 'de schoenen zijn te klein' counts; afvalpas adequacy criterion and note widened so that 'ik heb een afvalpas nodig' counts. edits.why: Decision on the author's doubt 1. The official educatie domain is the candidate's own study; a parent writing to the child's teacher is daily life, and the integrated B1 items about a child's school (016-medicijn-school, 017-eerste-schooldag) are tagged overig. Consistent tags matter more for coverage than the requested count; the batch is now werk 3 / educatie 1 / overig 4.

old: De zin zegt wat er mis is met de bestelling: de bezorgde schoenen hebben een andere maat dan de bestelde maat 43.
The sentence says what is wrong with the order: the delivered shoes are a different size from the ordered size 43.
Zeggen wat er mis is: de bezorgde schoenen hebben een andere maat dan de bestelde maat 43.
new: De zin zegt wat er mis is met de bestelling: de bezorgde schoenen hebben niet de goede maat, bijvoorbeeld een andere maat dan de bestelde maat 43, of ze zijn te klein of te groot.
The sentence says what is wrong with the order: the delivered shoes are not the right size, for example a different size from the ordered size 43, or they are too small or too big.
Zeggen wat er mis is: de bezorgde schoenen hebben niet de goede maat (een andere maat dan de bestelde maat 43, of te klein of te groot).
edits.why: 'maar de schoenen zijn helaas te klein' is the most natural learner sentence and makes the whole e-mail work (subject 'Verkeerde maat', 'ruilen voor de juiste maat'), but the old wording demanded a size other than 43 and would have failed it in the self-check and for the judge (rubric 4, 5). The sample still fails criterion 1 (it says nothing about size); the model still meets it; both starters fit.

old: De zin zegt dat de schrijver geen afvalpas voor het nieuwe adres heeft, bijvoorbeeld omdat er geen pas is achtergelaten, de pas niet is ontvangen of de oude pas niet werkt.
The sentence says that the writer has no waste pass for the new address, for example because no pass was left behind, no pass was received or the old pass does not work.
Zeggen dat de schrijver geen (werkende) afvalpas voor het nieuwe adres heeft: niet gekregen, niet gevonden of de pas werkt niet.
new: De zin zegt dat de schrijver geen (werkende) afvalpas voor het nieuwe adres heeft of er een nodig heeft, bijvoorbeeld omdat er geen pas is achtergelaten, de pas niet is ontvangen of de oude pas niet werkt.
The sentence says that the writer has no (working) waste pass for the new address or needs one, for example because no pass was left behind, no pass was received or the old pass does not work.
Zeggen dat de schrijver geen (werkende) afvalpas voor het nieuwe adres heeft of er een nodig heeft: niet gekregen, niet gevonden of de pas werkt niet.
edits.why: 'Ik heb voor dit adres een afvalpas nodig.' and 'Ik wil graag een afvalpas aanvragen.' introduce the pass so that 'Zonder de pas' and the closing question cohere; they fulfil the function without saying 'geen pas' and must count. '(werkende)' now matches the note. The sample (registration at the gemeente) still fails; the model still meets; both starters fit.

decisions_on_author_doubts.1_domain_tags: ophalen -> overig (E1); werkschoenen stays werk (safety shoes for a warehouse job, work vocabulary; a boundary case). Counts werk 3 / educatie 1 / overig 4; with batch 014: werk 6, educatie 4, overig 6.
decisions_on_author_doubts.2_dienstruil_sample: Keep. 'als jij wilt dat ik jouw avonddienst overneem' is a correct als-clause that paraphrases the body's first sentence and names no condition of the writer's own: the copied-prompt failure, 0 for adequacy; it also leaves 'Dan geef ik de ruil meteen door' without a ruil. Feedback should name it as a repetition of the request.
decisions_on_author_doubts.3_werkschoenen_vs_015_kledingkast: Distinct: one sentence naming a wrong size versus a korte schrijftaak about damage and late delivery; keep apart only if a mixed set is ever built.
decisions_on_author_doubts.4_maar_as_hoofdzin_trigger: Accepted. 'maar' coordinates like 'want'; the criterion states the second-position rule, so inversion after a fronted element inside the maar-clause earns the point and verb-third or verb-final order fails. A verbless continuation ('maar helaas in de verkeerde maat') is natural and adequate but shows no hoofdzin: no grammar point, to be explained as a missing clause.
decisions_on_author_doubts.5_volgens_het_huurcontract_as_inversion_: Accepted. A fronted prepositional phrase forces the finite verb into second position exactly as 'Daarom' does; no correct completion begins with the subject; it is the phrase learners write in such e-mails; the sample shows the error the task exists for.
decisions_on_author_doubts.6_als_read_as_when: Either reading is verb-final; 'Dat wil ik wel doen, als' makes the condition reading natural and criterion 1 asks for a condition. Keep.
decisions_on_author_doubts.7_body_length: Keep. 38-54 words in four or five sentences is a short e-mail; the 22-word sentence (ophalen) is two coordinated main clauses, none over 30 (blueprint 10); trimming a fact would weaken the time chain that forces the request.
decisions_on_author_doubts.8_afvalpas_sample: Keep: the off-topic failure is a real learner move and leaves 'Zonder de pas' without a referent.
decisions_on_author_doubts.9_two_moves: Accepted (both settings fixed by the coordinator); moving out versus moving in; placed in different drills.
decisions_on_author_doubts.10_manager_closing_groet: Keep 'Groet,': realistic to a manager on first-name terms, one more closing form in the bank.
decisions_on_author_doubts.11_no_second_person_in_ophalen_body: Fine; salutation, closing and the model's 'bij u' fix the register (as 014-sportschool).
decisions_on_author_doubts.12_deposit_term: The model's two weeks is the statutory term (Wet goed verhuurderschap: 14 days, 30 with deductions; Rijksoverheid page re-checked 2026-09-11); the criterion does not require the term. The e-mail is undated, so 'nog niet teruggekregen' holds either way.
decisions_on_author_doubts.13_slugs_and_concurrent_batches: Confirmed: no slug exists in any part of the catalogue or in batches 026-031; no checker warning. Cross-part echoes recorded in diversity_review.
decisions_on_author_doubts.14_wilgendam: Accepted under the coordinator's rule: no municipality exists (web search 2026-09-11: a street in Noordwijk, a farm in Belgium); the name occurs only in the to-address.

diversity_review: Eight settings, eight addressees, no cast name twice; six lead-in/structure combinations plus two open gaps; speech acts a rule statement, a request, a conditional agreement, two problem statements, an invitation, a consequence, a purpose; registers 4 + 4. Against the B1 writing catalogue and batch 029: no setting, addressee, organisation or lead-in recurs; with 014 there are twelve different frames for drills. Cross-part echoes (other parts, allowed): B1 speaking 002-cursusgemist (missed course evening) next to aantekeningen; 030-kat-voeren and 026-koken-buurvrouw (neighbour favours, Fatima) next to bedankje; 027-verhuizen and 031-afvalcontainers next to afvalpas; 031-verwarming-verhuurder and 016-slaapkamerraam (a landlord) next to borg; 029-kustweekend also opens on a holiday; Esdoornstraat also in A2 reading 021-trappenhuis. Only the fixed instruction sentences and the formula 'Kunt u mij laten weten …?' recur as phrases.
set_assembly: Drills of four (blueprint 11), two registers, three domains, four structures each, the two moves apart: drill 1 borg (inversie, F, overig), dienstruil (bijzin als, I, werk), werkschoenen (hoofdzin maar, F, werk), bedankje (vrij, I, overig); drill 2 ophalen (bijzin dat, F, overig), afvalpas (hoofdzin open, F, overig), aantekeningen (inversie, I, educatie), vrije-dag (te-infinitief, I, werk). Form: these eight plus 029's two deelschrijftaken and two korte schrijftaken make a second Schrijven I form (8 + 2 + 2); 029's own review (same day, another session) reports pass, so the form is complete once both batches are adopted; suggested order 1 borg, 2 dienstruil, 3 ophalen, 4 aantekeningen, 5 werkschoenen, 6 vrije-dag, 7 afvalpas, 8 bedankje (registers alternate, open gaps last, moves apart). content/blueprints/ does not exist; the form definition is a coordinator step.

Feedback instructions for zinstaken (the 014 list still stands): a verbless completion after 'maar' or 'Volgens het huurcontract' shows no hoofdzin or inversion and earns no grammar point, to be described as a missing clause; 'Helaas, ik heb …' with a comma is an interjection without inversion and not the target (like 'Misschien dat …'); the dienstruil sample is the copied-prompt failure; a finite verb followed by an extraposed prepositional phrase or om-te clause after dat/als is correct verb-final order.

Blueprint 4.8 and the author brief still describe only 'Schrijf één zin op de open plek.'; the lead-in convention of the 014 review is now used by two batches with two more trigger types (a fronted prepositional phrase, 'maar'); write it down.
